title: 进度
summary: 转圈只说了在等。先定进度能不能算：能算就走到 100 停住；不能算就循环，不要假百分比。
summaryEn: A spinner only says you are waiting. First decide whether progress can be measured: if it can, walk to 100 and stop; if it cannot, loop — never a fake percent.

links.when: 进度是工作正在发生，不是布局占位
links.whenEn: progress is work happening, not a layout placeholder

links.when: 进度能不能算不是这一段往上还是往下
links.whenEn: whether progress is measurable is not whether a session counts up or down

links.when: 工作进度不是文档滚过
links.whenEn: work progress is not how far the document has been read
